arguments.premise_synthesis: Confidence in Treasuries is undermined by the $38 trillion debt and growing deficits. Treasury buybacks are a sign of liquidity problems that will force the Fed to step in. Printing money to support debt is inflationary.
arguments.conclusion_supported: The conclusion establishes that the combination of unsustainable debt levels and buyback programs will inevitably force the Federal Reserve to monetize the debt, causing inflation and devaluation of the dollar.
